messages:
Erin: heads-up — getting paged for prod-us-east inference spikes, P50 latency ~1.8s and error rate creeping. I'm primary for the night but need to step away in 20m. Can someone take primary for the 22:00-02:00 window? I'll hand off current incident context.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC12345 created — service: inference-service-prod — symptom: high-latency + increased 5xx rate — P50=1800ms, P95=4.2s — affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. PagerDuty alert routed to @oncall.

Sam: I can jump in as primary for that window, @Erin want me to take over now or at 22:00? I can shadow the next 20m then be primary.

Erin: @Sam please take over now — I'm doing a quick handoff. Current mitigations in flight: 1) rolling restart of a stressed inference-pool node group 2) enabling KV-prefix caching for bursty routes 3) temporary routing to quantized-llama-13b as fallback for heavy requests. All automated, but watch for cache warm-up.

Maria: FYI I'm delayed, can't cover tonight after 22:30 (flight). I left notes in the runbook about the offline model fallback thresholds.

Jon: I can be secondary. I'll monitor traces and assist with rollbacks. Where's the runbook link and quick rollback steps?

Erin: Runbook here: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/inference-latency. Key snippets:

```
# promote fallback model
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"quantized-llama-13b","percent":100}'

# rollback routing
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"percent":0}'

# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=prod-us-east
```

Erin: current incident notes: leaning toward routing fallback because restarts haven't reduced tail latency yet. Cache warm-up is slow for large prompt sizes. Expect 5-10m for metrics to stabilize after toggle.

Sam: taking primary now. I'll announce in PD bridge and keep @Jon looped. Starting promote fallback to quantized model (running dry-run first).

Jon: watching traces, I'll open a quick viz for user-impact by customer tier and keep an eye on error distribution. If errors spike >8% or customer-impact shows top-tier customers degraded, I'll signal immediate rollback.

Erin: thanks. Quick checklist for handoff — please confirm in this thread when you accept: 1) PD bridge open 2) fallback promoted (or dry-run) 3) monitoring alerts muted/unmuted as appropriate 4) I'll drop a short summary before I step out.

Sam: confirm — PD bridge open (link shared in PD), fallback dry-run initiated, will promote if metrics look good in 3m. Muting the noisy latency alert channel for now.

oncall-bot: Note: Scheduled maintenance window at 23:00 UTC — will not affect this incident.

Maria: thx everyone, I'll catch up tomorrow morning on postmortem notes. // sorry about being late for the swap.

Erin: final: I'm handing off. @Sam you're primary, @Jon sec. I've pasted the most recent logs to the PD bridge and pinned them to the runbook. If anything changes, @Sam call for me — I should be reachable for 30m. :thumbsup:

Sam: acknowledged — taking full primary. Will update last_message_ts once we close the handoff.

Jon: acknowledged as secondary. Monitoring dashboards up.

Sam: handoff complete — last check at 5170012620. Metrics trending down after promote, will keep watch and escalate if necessary. :white_check_mark:
